question: What role does limb contemplation with the beloved play in this practice?
premises: All that is done here is addressed to the beloved
The practice is performed with her
inference: All these acts here, O beautiful-hipped one, involve limb contemplation performed with her.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of yāṃ is ambiguous in this fragment.
plain_english: All that here, O beautiful-hipped one, is the limb contemplation undertaken with her.
